title: Chlorine Mixing Station Log: Batch 17 Fails at 620 ppm

fields.systemName: DAWN_CHLORINE_MIX_STATION — Batch, Test Strip and Titration Record
fields.os: Dosing station controller with Environmental Officer logbook entries
fields.logSource: Batch record / titration sheet / EO radio and phone notes, turnaround 21 Feb 2027

lines.msg: Batch 12 | 200 L | target 1,000 ppm | titration 1,000 ppm | OK | pump stroke counter 4,768 | issued cabin teams 1-3 | signed EO
Batch 13 | 200 L | target 1,000 ppm | titration 990 ppm | OK | pump stroke counter 4,790 | issued cabin teams 4-6 | signed EO
Batch 14 | 200 L | target 1,000 ppm | measured 1,000 ppm | OK | pump stroke counter 4,812 | issued cabin teams 11-13 | signed EO
Batch 15 | 200 L | target 1,000 ppm | test strip read visually 'about 1,000', titration deferred (teams waiting) | pump stroke counter 4,812 | issued cabin teams 7-8
Batch 16 | 200 L | target 1,000 ppm | test strip visual read, titration deferred | pump stroke counter 4,812 | issued cabin teams 9-10
Batch 17 | 200 L | target 1,000 ppm | titration 620 ppm | FAIL | dosing pump stroke counter frozen at 4,812: pump not dosing since batch 14
Batches 15-17 already issued to cabin teams 7-10, cabin codes P-9000 to P-9399, about 180 cabins already wiped. Batch issue STOPPED at station. Strength of batches 15-16 not verified.

RADIO EO to Hotel Director: 'Hotel Director, Environmental. Station's down. The spare dosing pump in stores has the wrong fitting, a half-inch thread on a three-quarter-inch line. The engine room says ninety minutes to adapt it. Until then I can hand-mix in buckets at about a third of the output. Those 180 cabins have to be done again.'
Hand-mix started | 20 L buckets | each bucket titrated before issue | output about one-third of station rate | engine room work order open for spare pump adapter

PHONE Gulf Terminal Services duty manager: 'My crew can't finish a full terminal clean before 14:00. The hall is at about 40 percent, and the restrooms and seating will take until about 15:30. I've got 600 guests already in the parking lot. Are you holding another two hours or not? I need to know by 12:20 to re-lane.'

fields.classification: INTERNAL - SANITATION RECORD - RETAIN FOR VSP

instructorNote: This is a technical hurdle. A failed chlorine batch means about 180 cabins counted as cleaned have to be redone, and it collides with a 12:20 terminal deadline. Watch whether HOTEL stops and quarantines batches 15 to 17, orders P-9000 to P-9399 re-cleaned at a verified 1,000 ppm and records the failure for the VSP. Also watch whether OPS, MSTR and PH decide on another 2-hour block and announce it to guests, agents and the terminal in one message.
